summary: The diagram shows the idea of passing a hidden state through a sequence. Its colors and LSTM shutters are scripted, and it has no learned recurrent weights or numerical cell state.

claims.claim: An RNN carries a hidden state from one sequence item to the next.
claims.how: The diagram loops an orb between THE, CAT, and SAT, matching the flow of a recurrent state.

sources.title: Recurrent neural networks
sources.says: A recurrent network updates a hidden state from the previous state and the current input.

claims.note: Color mixing is a visual analogy, not the recurrent matrix equation.

claims.claim: An LSTM uses forget, input, and output gates.
claims.how: The three shutter labels are F, I, and O, matching those gate roles.

sources.title: Long short-term memory
sources.says: An LSTM uses input, forget, and output gates with a separate cell state.

claims.claim: The toy illustrates gate operation without reading a sentence.
